notes.title: Give Patch Quest a Chance in the Steam Awards!
notes.notes:
It would mean the World to Lychee Games if you would support them to be nominated in the innovative gameplay category in this year's Steam Awards!

With its groundbreaking blend of combat, exploration, and ever-evolving landscapes, Patch Quest is a strong contender for it's truly innovative gameplay. The game introduces a dynamic ecosystem where patches continuously reshape the world, challenging players to adapt and strategize in real-time.
This innovative approach not only sets Patch Quest apart but also provides an engaging and unpredictable gaming experience. As players navigate through procedurally generated environments, each playthrough becomes a unique adventure, showcasing the solo developer’s commitment to pushing the boundaries of traditional gameplay.

And of course, in what other game can you lasso a monster and take on their attacks and abilities?

There has been such phenomenal support for Patch Quest from the gaming community, and we hope you will consider nominating us! Please hit the nomination for Patch Quest in the Innovative Gameplay Category in the Steam Awards and get Patch Quest in the running!

notes.title: The Dungeon Crawler Update
notes.notes:
Welcome back to the vibrant and dangerous world of Patchlantis! 

Get ready to enjoy The Dungeon Crawler Update, which adds a whole new mode to Patch Quest - the Challenge Mode! 

[previewyoutube=fR5z9L_aX5A;full][/previewyoutube]

In this mode, you take on a wide variety of randomized dungeons, each with a gameplay twist. Use super-powered weapons, ride gigantic mounts, fight super-speedy monsters, and much more. 
 Over 20 different pre-set challenges to master and an editor to set up your own custom challenges. 
 Try out a huge variety of different gameplay mutators that make each challenge unique. 
 Earn bronze, silver, and gold medals to prove your skills. 
 

And as a bonus, there's also been an overhaul of each mountable monster's Passive Skills. A wide variety of new skills have been added, each of which is meant to benefit a particular play style. And almost every monster has been upgraded. 

 Biting mounts can use an extra melee attack to help you out in combat. 
 Sneaking mounts can evade enemies by sneaking through hazardous terrain unharmed. 
 Swimming mounts move especially fast through water and muddy ground. 
 A whole bunch more Passive Skills have been added too. 


And, of course, a range of minor bugs have also been fixed.

notes.title: Balance & Bug Fixes Update - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Balance Changes:

- The difficulty curves have been tweaked so that longer quests are more difficult. At first, this change won't be particularly obvious. But as the length of your quest increases, the difficulty will ramp up more sharply than before. This is meant to reduce the risk of some quests becoming infinitely long, when players outscale the game's difficulty.

- The Left Behinds charm now spawns 1-2 small critters, instead of 3 critters.

- The radius and damage dealt by the Blast Buddies charm has been decreased.

- The damage dealt by the Ricochet charm has been slightly decreased.

- It is now possible to summon pets inside of dungeons.
 
Bug Fixes:

- Fixed an issue where it was sometimes possible to leave Base Camp by fast travelling.

- Fixed an issue with typing Chinese text when renaming the island or your pets.

notes.title: PATCH QUEST – DATE CHANGE ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
We have some pretty big news to announce today - We have decided to keep Patch Quest in Early Access for one more update.

What Does This Mean?
We’ll still be releasing the new update on October 13th. Originally, we were planning to leave Early Access at this point. But instead, we're going to stay in Early Access until the following update releases (expected in February sometime).

Why Stay In Early Access?
There's actually a few good reasons:
 The game's final boss was going to be released in the post-launch update (in February), with a placeholder ending coming in this update. But a lot of people, both within the community and outside it, have said this is a bit weird. Normally a game would contain the full story when it launches.
 The game was recently translated into 10 languages, and those translations will arrive in the October update. So by keeping the game in Early Access a bit longer, we can start trying to market the game in multiple languages. And this hopefully will lead to a stronger launch.
 This frees up some more time for polishing and balancing. We want to make sure Patch Quest is in the best possible place when we start sending it out to content creators and reviewers, and a little bit of final polish can go a long way.
So What Happens Now?
In the grand scheme of things, not a lot changes. We are still releasing the October update and winter update, we are just delaying the point of official launch.

But it does mean we can move on from bug fixing now, and finally begin work on the Big Boss update. In fact, we’ll be starting immediately. So be sure to keep an eye out for our devlogs here and on Discord over the coming days and weeks.

notes.title: The Undersea Update - Out Now!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38199765/1d064791add8549b5a6521db9aaae0969bfe061e.jpg

The Ocean Awaits!
Explore 2 all-new Zones, and the undersea tunnels connecting them.

  The islands of the Glacier Zone have been gripped by vicious weather.
  The rivers of the Swamp Zone are teeming with life - both friends and foes! 
  Follow the Seafloor currents to discover a long-lost treasure...


New Monsters Lurk...
As always, there's a bunch of new fully-mountable monsters to battle with!

  Tadpog can easily command a large army of allied critters.
  Deardrop can summon pouring rain and blazing thunder!
  Pyrefly can curse his foes, leaving them haunted by a stream of ghosts.
  And more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38199765/58947cfe61c552dddbcc1ff1a4f9616ec546c06e.png
The Little Things
No update would be complete without all the minor tweaks and changes that go into polishing and balancing a game. Here's a few highlights...

  Several defense skills have stacking cooldowns so you can use them repeatedly!
  New monster subspecies have been added, with some unique new skills sprinkled in.
  Tweaks and improvements have been made to several older Zones.
  A whole bunch of bugs have been fixed.


Developer's Note
This update adds loads of new content, bringing the number of zones up to 10! This means there's only two zones left to add! So my next steps will be to add those final zones and complete the game's overworld.
As always, your feedback is a central part of Patch Quest development. So feel free to drop your thoughts at discord.gg/patchquest

notes.title: The Monster Ranching Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38199765/00b96ebbac8164b594a1fb81dced6d7da375691d.png

Collect Every Monster!

Your base camp has been expanded and you can now keep way more pets than ever before!

 Keep a pet of every monster species
 Equip 5 of your pets to bring questing with you 
 You can now send a new pet to Base Camp without ending your run
 Play fetch with them!


Unlock New Super Skills!

Summon allies, grow tentacles, split in half or possess another monster.  A variety of powerful new Super Skills have been added and every monster has one!

 Super Skills have been rebalanced and revamped so they're much stronger than before
 They can now be used once per battle, and don't cost stamina to use
 They now unlock when your mount reaches level 4


3 New Challengers Approach!

3 new mountable monsters have been added, in preparation for the upcoming Swamp Zone and Glacier Zone. They appear as rare spawns in a variety of habitats.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38199765/500796b826c5837052f4e6c2e3ca5e483f794f43.png

 Snooth can draw energy from it's symbiotic fungus to super-size and bulldoze its foes
 Wolphin are social monsters that hunt in pairs and can travel through rushing rapids with ease
 Poven can bake clay into armour with its intense bodyheat. It has the power to roast hostile shots, clearing them.


Turn Up The Heat!

Hard mode is finally here! Your difficulty settings can be changed in the pause menu, at any time between quests.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38199765/5221c527adf8f379d12a641cd1d3c1ce28a04603.png

 Choose your own difficulty level, with 10 notches of increasing danger
 At higher difficulties, rare Shiny Pins are much more likely to spawn



Developer's Notes

Players have been asking to keep more than 5 pets for a long time, so this update allows you to keep dozens of them. I've also updated a bunch of the mechanics related to capturing and leveling up your pets, to make the experience of pet collecting much more fun.

My next steps will be to start adding new content for the upcoming Swamp and Glacier zones. 

- Lemon

notes.title: The Jurassic Update - Out Now!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38199765/56ca02f47d4a76d824de637c4540f3beb1e8f34d.png
A thundering noise rings out! Was it a volcanic eruption, or a monstrous roar? ...It might have been both!


A Lost World... Rediscovered!

Discover 2 all-new zones! Can you clear them both and defeat the ancient golem that waits deep within?

 Patrolled by a vicious predator, The Fossil Zone hides a secret in its tarry pits.
 A meteorite shower is pummeling the Volcanic Zone. Crossing it won't be simple!
 Explore a variety of sub-areas with bouncy jelly rivers and scorching hot magma.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38199765/83ebd027b1a24197f354901a340658e84f8cf545.png
Gather Your Strength

Building on the previous update (the Power Surge update) there's more ways than ever before to bend nature's hazards to your advantage.

 Dangerous plants now grow in battle rooms. But many can be turned back on the monsters you're fighting!
 Pickups are everywhere, if you know what to look for. Be sure to rustle any suspicious-looking plants.
 With new zones comes new prehistoric-themed monsters to ride and master. 


The Little Things

No update would be complete without all the minor tweaks and changes that go into polishing and balancing a game. Here's a few highlights...

 The Hive Zone and Zen Zone have been spruced up with some new content.
 Several older monsters have been buffed or tweaked so they're more fun to play as.
 The level generator has been upgraded with some new tricks and patterns.
 New UI markers below the player help you see when skills are off-cooldown.


Developer's Note
This update adds a bunch of new content, bringing the number of zones up to 8 (out of the planned 12). It feels great to watch the overworld map expand like this.
I've also been listening to a lot of player feedback over on the Discord server. With your help, I've been sprucing up the older zones and monsters. 
And I've paid special attention to the game's overall difficulty curves, to ease players from playful exploration into frantic battles as each run develops.
As always, your feedback is a central part of Patch Quest development. So feel free to drop your thoughts at discord.gg/patchquest

notes.title: Patch Quest "Power Surge" Update - Out Now!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38199765/44059f35133870d59b1d756cc458597162a34b2d.png

A Sinister Wind Is Blowing...

Once docile, the monsters of Patchlantis have been filled with a frenzied rage!


 As you explore, a Sinister Wind will blow across Patchlantis. 
 This wind makes monsters faster, tougher and stronger each time it blows. 
 Even the strongest explorers will be overwhelmed eventually!

Get Ready to Power Up!

Fortunately, monsters aren't the only ones with new powerups!


20 all-new Charms have been added to the game, each one granting a special, synergising effect.
Your 5 Base Stats have been buffed, now stacking all the way to 100 points each!
Use your newfound strength to unlock new shortcuts before the monsters overwhelm you! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38199765/e6a7ba2b757de5f8a083dc862f157fb6e7996c16.png

Tricks, Traps and Totems!

I've upgraded the level generator with a bunch of new traps and patterns.


A variety of new Trap and Totem types will spawn in many areas. 
Devilish new hazard patterns will spawn in corridors and test your dodging skills.
Hot Air Vents let you skip some battles, and make backtracking much more pleasant.
Several sub-habitats have been revamped, and an extra one has been added.


My Reasoning Behind This Update

Patch Quest is a fusion between the roguelite and metroidvania genres, which can be a delicate balance to get right. In recent months, the vania side of the gameplay has improved a lot, but the rogue elements were getting a little lost.

These new changes bring a stronger sense of progression over the length of a quest. You'll become much more powerful - but the monsters will become much more powerful too! You'll need to make good use of the synergies between your stats and charms to unlock new shortcuts and reach deeper into Patchlantis.

- Lemon

notes.title: Small Day 1 Bug Fixing Update
notes.notes:
A small subset of players have been reporting that Patch Quest won't properly start up for them.

After some digging, it turns out the crash is related to the game's Discord integration (which lets you earn special roles on the PQ Discord server as you play).

It's not clear why the crash happens for some people and not others. But to fix it, I've added a toggle for the Discord features. 

Hopefully this has fixed things for everyone! :)
